infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Velocity Rides needs access to your photos so you can share pictures in chat and upload verification documents.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Velocity Rides uses the camera so you can share photos in chat and capture verification documents, and so drivers can record rides with the in-car dash cam.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Velocity Rides uses your location to match nearby rides, enable live trip tracking, and share your location in chat.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Velocity Rides lets you pick a contact to share their number in chat.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Velocity Rides uses your microphone for free in-app calls with your driver, your passenger or our helpline, so you can book a ride by speaking instead of typing, and so drivers can record sound with the in-car dash cam.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Velocity Rides turns your speech into a ride booking. Recognition happens on your device.
